name: Consistent Histories
one_line: The Consistent Histories approach reformulates quantum mechanics in terms of 'histories,' which are sequences of properties at different points in time.

math_relation_to_SQM.equations_summary: Uses the standard mathematical machinery of SQM but reorganizes it into a logical framework based on histories and projection operators. It aims to make the probabilistic structure of SQM more explicit.
